Lead Response and // Follow-Up Automation were consolidated into Axiom Lead Automation. function aliases() { return array( 'growth-system' => 'growth', 'review-automation' => 'essential', 'lead-response' => 'lead-automation', 'follow-up-automation' => 'lead-automation', ); } function current_plan() { if ( empty( $_GET['plan'] ) ) { return null; } $key = sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['plan'] ) ); $aliases = aliases(); $plans = plans(); $target = isset( $aliases[ $key ] ) ? $aliases[ $key ] : $key; // The recorded key keeps the original parameter so legacy links stay traceable. return isset( $plans[ $target ] ) ? array( $key, $plans[ $target ][0], $plans[ $target ][1] ) : null; } function styles() { return ''; } function script( $label ) { $data = wp_json_encode( array( 'def' => DEFAULT_PLAN, 'label' => $label, ) ); // Mobile keyboards and autofill hints; keep the plan label in the hidden field. return ''; } function render_form() { $plan = current_plan(); $label = $plan ? $plan[1] . ' — ' . $plan[2] . ' (plan=' . $plan[0] . ')' : ''; $form = do_blocks( '' ); if ( $label ) { // Server-side: set the hidden field's value (input value and the // interactivity context). Labels come from the allowlist above and // contain no quote, backslash or markup characters. $form = str_replace( DEFAULT_PLAN, $label, $form ); } $html = styles() . '

Interested in' . esc_html( $plan[1] ) . ' — ' . esc_html( $plan[2] ) . '

'; $html .= script( $label ); $html .= lead_tracking_script(); return $html; } /** * True only for a recent, non-spam entry from the Get Started form. * Jetpack reports success for Akismet spam too, so the stored status decides. */ function lead_is_countable( $entry_id ) { $post = get_post( $entry_id ); if ( ! $post || 'feedback' !== $post->post_type || 'publish' !== $post->post_status ) { return false; } if ( FORM_ID !== (int) $post->post_parent ) { return false; } return ( time() - (int) get_post_time( 'U', true, $post ) ) <= LEAD_MAX_AGE; } add_action( 'rest_api_init', function () { register_rest_route( 'axiom/v1', '/lead-check', array( 'methods' => 'POST', 'permission_callback' => '__return_true', 'args' => array( 'id' => array( 'type' => 'integer', 'required' => true, 'minimum' => 1, ), ), 'callback' => function ( $request ) { $response = rest_ensure_response( array( 'countable' => lead_is_countable( (int) $request['id'] ) ) ); $response->header( 'Cache-Control', 'no-store' ); return $response; }, ) ); } ); /** * Fires the lead conversion once per accepted, non-spam submission. It reads * Jetpack's own AJAX response (success + entry ID), confirms the entry * server-side, then sends only send_to and a non-personal transaction ID. */ function lead_tracking_script() { $cfg = wp_json_encode( array( 'dest' => LEAD_CONVERSION_SEND_TO, 'check' => esc_url_raw( rest_url( 'axiom/v1/lead-check' ) ), ) ); return ''; } function replace_marker( $content ) { if ( ! is_string( $content ) || false === strpos( $content, MARKER ) ) { return $content; } return preg_replace_callback( '#]*>\s*' . MARKER . '\s*

#', function () { return render_form(); }, $content, 1 ); } add_filter( 'elementor/frontend/the_content', __NAMESPACE__ . '\\replace_marker', 20 ); add_filter( 'the_content', __NAMESPACE__ . '\\replace_marker', 999 );
